queries.c17-thoughts-by-day: SELECT field(kind, THOUGHT) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-talk-by-day: SELECT field(kind, AGENT_TALK) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-susp-full-by-day: SELECT field(kind, THOUGHT) AND (contains(c17susp) OR contains(c17liar) OR contains(c17game)) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-susp-core-by-day: SELECT field(kind, THOUGHT) AND (contains(c17susp) OR contains(c17liar)) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-susp-core-nogame-by-day: SELECT field(kind, THOUGHT) AND (contains(c17susp) OR contains(c17liar)) AND NOT contains(c17game) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-control-thought-by-day: SELECT field(kind, THOUGHT) AND contains(c17ctrl) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-contra-by-day: SELECT field(kind, AGENT_TALK) AND contains(c17contra) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-contra-directed-by-day: SELECT field(kind, AGENT_TALK) AND contains(c17contra) AND mentions_user($y) AND field(agent, !$y) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-conc-by-day: SELECT field(kind, AGENT_TALK) AND contains(c17conc) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
queries.c17-control-talk-by-day: SELECT field(kind, AGENT_TALK) AND contains(c17ctrl) GROUP BY DAYS(time) AGGREGATE count()
